english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for something easy to understand, and it also describes speech or sound that is easy to hear distinctly.
This is the all-purpose spoken choice when something is clear and leaves no room for misunderstanding.
Use this when the speech, explanation, or wording is clear and easy to understand.

examples.english: This report is very clear; you understand it after one read.
examples.traditional: 呢份報告寫得好清楚，睇一次就明。
examples.jyutping: ni1 fan6 bou3 gou3 se2 dak1 hou2 cing1 co2 tai2 jat1 ci3 zau6 ming4

examples.english: You were so unequivocal that I don’t need to guess anymore.
examples.traditional: 你講得咁清楚，我唔使再估喇。
examples.jyutping: nei5 gong2 dak1 gam3 cing1 co2 ngo5 m4 sai2 zoi3 gu2 laa3

examples.english: You articulate yourself very clearly, so I understand as soon as I hear you.
examples.traditional: 你講得好清楚，我一聽就明。
examples.jyutping: nei5 gong2 dak1 hou2 cing1 co2 ngo5 jat1 teng1 zau6 ming4
